description: Agent Grants: submit a grant application with the funder’s call or guidelines for the grant: the application with the grant, the applicant, each eligibility criterion it states the applicant meets, each section it includes, the amount requested and its currency, when it was submitted and each attachment it includes; the call with its reference, the grant, each eligibility criterion, each required section, the budget cap and its currency, the submission deadline and each required attachment. The signed report gives the application and the call, each eligibility criterion, required section and required attachment matched to one the application holds with every one left out named, the amount requested against the budget cap and the submission against the deadline, and counts them, and names a divergent application: an eligibility criterion, required section or required attachment left out of the application, another currency, a request above the budget cap and a submission after the deadline; then another grant name, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A list, amount or submission time the call states and the application leaves out, or a call that states none of the five, leaves the application unverified. Criteria, sections and attachments read by their words with plurals folded, the amount compares to the cent in one currency, and the submission compares to the minute where both carry a time of day, otherwise by the day. This reads eligibility only as each document states it and decides no eligibility: wever_refund-eligibility-check reads one purchase against a refund policy and decides whether a refund claim fits it, while the application check decides no claim and reads a grant application’s stated eligibility against the call’s stated criteria; and wever_build-bid-check reads a contractor bid against the project scope or request it answers, line by line with quantities and amounts, while the application check reads a grant application’s eligibility, sections, request, submission and attachments against the funder’s call and submits nothing. Verdict grant_application_divergent, grant_application_partial, grant_application_unverified or grant_application_consistent. POST /api/grant-application-check. Reads the grant records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never applies for a grant, awards one, disburses or moves any money, or judges the merit of an applicant, a project, or a funder’s decision, only whether the records agree with each other and with the terms they were written under, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Grants reads a grant’s records for consistency between documents: a grant application, a proposed budget, an award letter or grant agreement, milestone records, disbursement records, spending records, a progress or final report and a closeout record, each against the call or guidelines, the terms in the call or award, the application as submitted, the schedules in the award, the approved budget, the records it summarizes or the award terms it should agree with. Beside it, the conditional payments rail tools such as wever_conditional-create create, fund, cancel and report on payments held against conditions between parties, keeping state and moving money, and the Job Records tools such as wever_job-cost-brief read the records of paid work orders, while this family keeps no state, moves nothing, commissions no work and reads the grant records in the call against each other and against the terms they were written under. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-grants-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-grants/.
